## Open Source Projects (GitHub: github.com/abiyeenzo)
- **easy-language**: French-language interpreted programming language (.elg files), written in pure C with inline x86-64 assembly optimizations. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/easy-language
- **CVE-2025-8671**: Educational proof-of-concept for CVE-2025-8671 (HTTP/2 DoS on lighttpd), lab-only vulnerability research. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/CVE-2025-8671
- **qr_pointage_system**: QR-code-based check-in/check-out system with SQLite storage and daily Excel export. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/qr_pointage_system
- **Mathor**: Python math expression interpreter (.mth files) for arithmetic and single-unknown equation solving. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/Mathor
